chu_de: Tra loi bao cao 02/10: dong bang E:, lay ma khong can Git, khoi phuc, thiet lap kenh
noi_dung:
Phien cloud gui phien nha (tra loi bao cao 02/10):
1) DUNG GHI len E:/D:. Chay ngay: Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\' -TaskName 'ScheduledDefrag'. Thoat Riot, khong cap nhat game.
2) Chua co Git thi dung cho: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\khoi_phuc\clone_khong_can_git.ps1 (Dulwich). Cai Git bang khoi_phuc\cai_git.ps1 (mirror, resume, kiem SHA-256).
3) Khoi phuc du lieu: doc tai_lieu/KHOI_PHUC_DU_LIEU.md; chay khoi_phuc\kiem_o_dia.ps1 (chi doc) va bao ket qua bang /bao-len. Hoi chu du an: Windows cai lai bang cach nao (Reset this PC > Remove everything > All drives / Clean data?) - quyet dinh co hoi cuu E: hay khong.
4) TestDisk chi khi chu du an dong y (da tu choi truoc do). Moi cong cu khoi phuc: DICH phai la o khac E:, khong bam Write trong TestDisk khi chua chep du lieu ra.
5) Thiet lap kenh: .\b.cmd cau hook-cai ; .\b.cmd cau dat-session session_01ER1xpfauUywJ6smLMSZmHW ; roi /bao-len de thu.
